address: 129 Linsen Road, East District, Hsinchu City, Taiwan
bio: A descendant of a century-old Chinese herbal shop, the owner came up with a plant-based gua bao recipe for his vegan wife. The fluffy bun is stuffed with assorted herbs, veggies and mushrooms. Rather than rich pork belly gua bao, you will taste intriguing layers of herbal flavours and textures. The menu is concise and everything comes with herbal ingredients. Also try the fragrant Chinese angelica soup and the nourishing yam and lily bulb soup.
